B.Ramesh vs State Of Odisha .... Opposite Party on 4 February,
2022
Author: Sashikanta Mishra
Bench: Sashikanta Mishra
              IN THE HIGH COURT OF ORISSA AT CUTTACK
                              BLAPL No.888 of 2022
            B.Ramesh                                ....          Petitioner
                                                    Mr. P. Roy,
                                                    Advocate
                                       -versus-
            State of Odisha                        ....       Opposite Party
                                               Miss S. Mishra
                                               Addl. Standing Counsel
                       CORAM:
                                 JUSTICE SASHIKANTA MISHRA
                                      ORDER
04.2.2022.
Order No.
01. 1. This matter is taken up through virtual mode.
2. Heard Mr. P. Roy, learned counsel for the Petitioner and Miss S. Mishra, learned Addl. Standing
Counsel for the State.
3. The Petitioner is in custody since 16th November, 2021 in connection with Semiliguda P.S. Case
No.108/2021 corresponding to G.R. Case No.71/2021 pending in the court of learned J.M.F.C,
Semiliguda for the alleged commission of the offence under Section 420/272/273/34 of the I.P.C.
read with Sections 51/52/56/57/59 of Food Safety and Standards Act.
// 2 //
4. Considering the submissions made, the materials on record, the period of detention already
undergone and the fact that investigation into the case appears to have progressed substantially, I

5. Let the Petitioner be released on bail on such terms and conditions as may be imposed by the

6. The BLAPL is disposed of.
7. As the restrictions due to resurgence of COVID-19 situation are continuing, learned counsel for
the parties may utilize a printout of the order available in the High court's website, at par with

texts.facts_text: This matter is taken up through virtual mode. The Petitioner is in custody since 16th November, 2021 in connection with Semiliguda P.S. Case No.108/2021 corresponding to G.R. Case No.71/2021 pending in the court of learned J.M.F.C, Semiliguda for the alleged commission of the offence under Section 420/272/273/34 of the I.P.C. read with Sections 51/52/56/57/59 of Food Safety and Standards Act.
texts.decision_text: Considering the submissions made, the materials on record, the period of detention already undergone and the fact that investigation into the case appears to have progressed substantially, I am inclined to allow the prayer for bail. Let the Petitioner be released on bail on such terms and conditions as may be imposed by the court in seisin over the matter in the aforesaid case including the condition that he shall appear before the trial court on each date of posting of the case without fail. The BLAPL is disposed of.
